     § 19:2-13.7. Decision. [Ord. 6 PSF-A(S), 9-5-2017; amended 9-18-2024 by Ord. No. 6PSF-I,
     09-18-2024]
     The Rent Control Board shall make a final decision no later than 15 days after the conclusion of
     the hearing. No rent adjustment shall be granted unless supported by the preponderance of the
     evidence submitted at the hearing. All parties shall be sent a notice of the Board's decision and
     a copy of the finding of fact and law upon which decision is based. At the same time, parties to
     the proceeding shall also be notified of their right to judicial review of the decision pursuant to
     Section 19:2-15.

     § 19:2-13.8. Hearing Officer. [Ord. 6 PSF-A(S), 9-5-2017; amended 9-18-2024 by Ord. No.
     6PSF-I, 09-18-2024]
     The Rent Control Board may at its discretion designate individuals with professional training in
     law, business administration, or similar field to serve as hearing officers to preside over landlord-
     tenant hearings when it determines that the number of petitions for hearings before the Board are
     so great that the Board could not hear them all itself within the time limits prescribed for such
     action by this chapter. The findings of the hearings conducted by him/her shall be submitted to the
     Board which, after review, shall make the final ruling.
